title: ItemFeedbackRule
description: Protected versioned hint, targeted feedback or model solution bound to an exact item version.

id.description: Immutable rule UUID within the institution.

item_version_id.description: Owning exact ItemVersion. Require same bank, version and protected authoring scope.
item_version_id.x-reference-scope: Owning exact ItemVersion. Require same bank, version and protected authoring scope.

key.description: Stable local rule key within the item version.

ordinal.description: Stable authored evaluation and disclosure sequence.

trigger.description: Approved disclosure trigger family, separate from delivery visibility.

interaction_key.description: Optional exact response control in the owning item version.

criterion_key.description: Optional exact criterion binding key in the owning item version.

predicate.description: Private typed trigger operands interpreted under the pinned match profile.

content.description: Protected sanitized rich body with immutable asset references.

x-invariants: On-demand and solution rules have no answer predicate. Targeted rules require exactly the operands for their trigger.
Interaction, criterion and choice keys resolve in the same version. Matcher profile must be bounded and approved.
Content, predicates and source answer identities stay out of candidate form, disclosure metadata and public grade projections until individually authorized.
Published rule is immutable. A replacement creates another ItemVersion.
